audit: DeeToo Rider 24-screen frontend vs backend capability

classification.Existing: Core server workflow exposed to Rider; no approved screen is yet integrated.
classification.Partial: Some reusable API/model exists; approved screen has contract/service gaps.
classification.Missing: No Rider-scoped API or operating model for the core approved feature.

screens.title: Login & Authentication
screens.remainingWork: Connect native secure session and recovery; phone verification OTP is not automatically a Rider login-challenge workflow; certify MFA flows.

screens.title: Rider Registration
screens.remainingWork: No public Rider self-registration/activation journey. Emergency contact, address, birth date and National ID are not persisted by Rider profile schema. Define eligible registration + consent/identity verification.

screens.title: Document Verification
screens.remainingWork: Private storage exists but no rider document catalogue, per-document review/expiry/rejection/resubmission endpoints or mandatory verification binding to onboarding approval.

screens.title: Vehicle & Equipment Registration
screens.remainingWork: Vehicle type/plate exist; make/model, year, insurance/logbook/helmet/bag equipment and compliance records are missing. Rider can set vehicle ACTIVE without document reapproval.

screens.title: Onboarding Status
screens.remainingWork: Overall review decisions exist; per-document rejection reasons/checklist, resubmission lifecycle, verified eligibility and event notification need completion. Current submit checks name/phone and vehicle presence only.

screens.title: Rider Dashboard
screens.remainingWork: Backend supplies account restrictions, earnings and zone IDs; compose dashboard adapter, real geospatial map/zone visualization, loading/error/live state and aggregation.

screens.title: Incoming Delivery Request
screens.remainingWork: Use server-calculated offer expiry/pay/ETA and dispatch ownership, not 25-second client fixture. Special handling and offer UI fields must be mapped.

screens.title: Active Delivery Details
screens.remainingWork: Assigned-Rider detail exposes pickup/drop-off, items, status and timestamps. Bind timeline, contact-safe affordances and error states; do not expose private details after delivery.

screens.title: Navigate to Merchant
screens.remainingWork: External Google Maps link and location plumbing exist; embedded live route, turn-by-turn, traffic-adjusted ETA and merchant contact action need adapters/provider contract.

screens.title: Merchant Pickup Confirmation
screens.remainingWork: Order READY and pickup verification code enforced server-side; no persisted rider item-by-item checklist or missing-item triage contract for UI.

screens.title: Navigate to Customer
screens.remainingWork: Recipient/location/instructions and milestones exist. Need live navigation/ETA and privacy-safe contact channel integration; not merely illustrative map.

screens.title: Customer Handover & Delivery Confirmation
screens.remainingWork: Real OTP lockout and assigned-rider verified PHOTO proof supported. UI must use uploaded media UUID, authorized proof policy and fail/incident resolution; never trust staged photo/fixture PIN.

screens.title: Delivery Completion Summary
screens.remainingWork: Delivery status and ledger earning creation exist, but Rider completion-detail API is blocked after DELIVERED; add a privacy-limited immutable receipt with actual fee components and posted state.

screens.title: Active Deliveries & Multiple Orders
screens.remainingWork: Stacked jobs and server-owned multi-stop sequence not supported: dispatcher excludes riders with active delivery, repository returns one. Do not enable second order or rider route reorder until dispatch/custody architecture supports it.

screens.title: Delivery History
screens.remainingWork: Internal filtered delivery queries exist but no owned Rider history/list/detail route for terminal statuses; add pagination, scoped completed/cancelled/failed history and privacy-reduced completed receipts.

screens.title: Earnings Dashboard
screens.remainingWork: Financial source and fee component records exist; no bounded day/week/month earnings-series API or incentive/adjustment chart aggregation. Define KES minor-unit mapping and date semantics.

screens.title: Rider Wallet & Cash Management
screens.remainingWork: Wallet already separates payable/available, pending earnings, collected cash, cash owed, settlement and reconciliation. A distinct discrepancy support workflow can reuse support/trust services; no rider-led ledger reconciliation.

screens.title: Payouts & Transactions
screens.remainingWork: Real payout batching/provider callbacks exist. Rider lacks authenticated self-service withdrawal request and M-PESA destination change/confirmation. Preserve maker/checker and provider-only payment proof; do not expose admin pay endpoints.

screens.title: Performance & Ratings
screens.remainingWork: Rates and completion/acceptance metrics exist; needs rider-scoped feedback/comment list, trend time buckets and achievements definitions. Ratings remain customer-sourced.

screens.title: Notifications Center
screens.remainingWork: Persistent recipient-scoped inbox and single-message read supported. Missing server-side preferences, critical-alert enforcement, mark-all-read and categorization contract for approved UI.

screens.title: Rider Support Center
screens.remainingWork: Participant-scoped case CRUD exists, BUT POST /support/cases passes client order_id into SupportService without rider/order ownership validation. Must reject foreign order/delivery/payment links before creating a cross-party case; verify all linked participants and add negative-role tests.

screens.title: Support Conversation
screens.remainingWork: Messages, media and participant confirmation exist, BUT respondToResolution transitions to RESOLVED when all participants ACCEPT, without Admin action. Preserve rider satisfaction inputs but require a separate authorized Admin final resolution and maintain immutable history.

screens.title: Safety & Incident Reporting
screens.remainingWork: Operations incident engine/status timeline exists but no scoped Rider create/list/detail/attach-incident endpoint. Add safety intake with optional order, severity triage, evidence ACL, rider visibility, emergency guidance. Admin remains sole resolver.

screens.title: Rider Profile & Settings
screens.remainingWork: Only first/last name/phone/vehicle type/plate self-edit. Missing emergency/address, verified field change requests, Rider M-PESA destination request, server notification preferences and rider deactivation/deletion request. Reverification guard needed.
